seo.title: About | NexusContent
seo.description: Why NexusContent exists: a clean boundary between content sources and the applications that consume them.

hero.heading: We make content replaceable.
hero.body: NexusContent is an open source content abstraction and integration layer. It normalizes content from any source into one predictable interface, so migrations stop being rewrites.

rich_text.heading: Our story
rich_text.body:
Every modern website copies the same data out of a CMS or a repository and hand-maps it into components. When the source changes, the mapping has to change too.

NexusContent draws a line: content sources provide normalized content, and applications consume that normalized content. Providers handle the differences. Consumers stay boring.

This repository proves the architecture with a Git JSON content source and a WordPress REST source behind the same pages, components, and schema.

image_text.heading: Content first, page later
image_text.body: Providers normalize pages, collections, media, navigation, and settings. Schema validation checks the content before it reaches a component. Only then does the frontend decide how to present it.
